d:
Story set before and after Chrono Cross (Chrono Trigger's sequel) focusing on what happened to Flea, the magician ladyboy from Chrono Trigger who was one of the 3 generals to evil overlord Magus.

This story builds on a theory about a certain character from Chrono Cross being someone very close to Magus (the reference and clue was lost in translation)

Has bonus artworks featuring Flea getting her dick pumped by a machine, and also a 2 pages long 8-panles koma feautring Nagaette from Chrono Trigger.
